pages.title: Cold Forging Basics
pages.text: §3Welcome, young crafter!§r$(br2)Cold forging is the core crafting system of this mod. From crafting the crudest stone tools, to finding natural metals, preparing billets, heating and softening (copper), and finally forging useful metal tools on a stone anvil.$(br2)You won't smelt metal in a furnace — instead, use a §4stone anvil§r and various tools to shape metal into useful items.

pages.title: Basic Controls
pages.text: $(li)Hold hammer and §5left-click§r on anvil to forge metal$(br)$(li)Hold axe and §5right-click§r on anvil to process metal$(br)$(li)Hold chisel and §5left-click§r on anvil to carve final products$(br)$(li)Hold §2Shift§r to view detailed item information$(br)$(li)Use §4/forgeodyssey find§r to quickly locate natural metals$(br)$(li)Use §3wooden clamp§r for hot items — bare hands will get burned

pages.title: Step 1: Make Billets
pages.text: $(li)Craft a §4Boulder Anvil§r using 1 boulder block + 1 surface cobblestone (quartzite/quartz sandstone/coarse sandstone/basalt)$(br)$(li)Combine natural metal block + water bucket = billet$(br)$(li)Each billet has random weight and quality$(br2)§4Tip:§r You can craft multiple times to get a higher weight billet.

pages.title: Step 2: Heat the Billet (Copper Only)
pages.text: §4Note: Only copper billets can be softened by heating. Silver and gold billets can be forged directly on the anvil (weight must be ≥50g).§r$(br2)Copper billet heating process:$(br)$(li)Craft and place a §4Fire Pit§r$(br)$(li)Add fuel (firewood, straw bale) to the fire pit$(br)$(li)Right-click the fire pit to ignite it$(br)$(li)Put the billet in the fire pit to heat$(br)$(li)Wait for it to become a §5softened billet§r$(br2)§cWARNING:§r Use wooden clamp to retrieve hot items!

pages.title: Step 3: Forge on Anvil
pages.text: Place the billet (copper must be softened first; silver/gold can be used directly) on the anvil, then:$(br2)$(li)§4Hammer§r (left-click): Forges billet into metal sheet$(br)$(li)§4Axe§r (right-click): Bends sheet into curve$(br)$(li)§4Axe§r (right-click): Bends curve into slot$(br)$(li)§4Chisel§r (left-click): Carves slot into knife$(br)$(li)§4Hammer§r (left-click): Forges curve into axe head$(br)$(li)§4Hammer§r (left-click): Forges slot into sword blade

pages.title: Step 4: Final Products
pages.text: From the basic forging process, you can create:$(br2)$(li)§cPrimitive Knife§r — from slot + chisel carving$(br)$(li)§cAxe Head§r — from curve + hammer forging$(br)$(li)§cSword Blade§r — from slot + hammer forging$(br)$(li)§cCopper:§r Slot → Ring → Hook → Pin (axe, progressive)$(br)$(li)§cSilver/Gold:§r Slot → Pin directly (no ring or hook stage)$(br)$(li)§cCopper Fishing Rod§r — copper ring + copper hook + line + stick$(br2)§4Tip:§r Recipes may change with mod updates; check the actual crafting recipe for details.

pages.title: Billet Cooling
pages.text: Softened copper billets will eventually cool down:$(br2)$(li)§3Water Cooling:§r Drop in water to cool instantly$(br)$(li)§3Natural Cooling:§r Soft copper billets cool after a period of time in inventory$(br2)Once cooled, billets return to hard state and must be reheated.$(br2)§4Note:§r Silver and gold billets don't have a softened state; they can be forged directly without cooling management.
